_about: The five styles of workflow 4 (atlas/ALIEN.md 8.4), as the ideas and script stages read them. ids match _shell/styles.json. buildable: film_long.py has the builder and the engine draws it today; a style that is not buildable is never offered.

styles.name: The Ledger
styles.look: A landscape documentary whose visual treatment comes from its own verified archive: real moving footage, restrained captions, evidence graphics only when they explain the mechanism. Choose typography and colour to suit this story. No fixed desk, ledger, chapter durations or borrowed story skeleton.
styles.hook: The conflict is visible and spoken within ten seconds.
styles.close: Resolve the central question with evidence and a human consequence.
styles.needs: A factual story with plentiful moving archive footage, original voices and a consequential turn in every chapter.
